items.title: Gencor Stock Surges Post Q3 Earnings, Revenues and Backlog Increase
items.summary: Gencor Industries (GENC) shares surged 24.4% following strong Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings, with net revenues up 25.3% to $33.8 million and earnings per share increasing 50% to $0.39. The company also reported a record backlog of $79.2 million and significant increases in cash and marketable securities. Management expressed confidence in continued performance, driven by infrastructure spending and strong operational execution, despite potential risks from tariffs, inflation, and geopolitical instability.

items.title: How e.l.f. Beauty Shifted Its Supply Chain Away From China

This initiative is part of a broader strategy to enhance supply chain resilience and address market dynamics.

items.title: 3 Oil & Gas Drilling Stocks Bucking a Bearish Industry Trend
items.summary: Despite a bearish industry outlook, the Oil and Gas - Drilling sector has seen strong performance over the past year, with a 68.9% gain. This article highlights Patterson-UTI Energy (PTEN), Nabors Industries (NBR), and Helmerich & Payne (HP) as standout companies. These companies are well-positioned due to their advanced assets, international opportunities, technology investments, and improving earnings prospects, allowing them to buck negative industry trends like commodity price volatility and geopolitical risks.

items.title: Wall Street Pricey? Try These 5 Dividend ETFs Under $50
items.summary: With Wall Street rallying despite geopolitical tensions and interest rate concerns, many retail investors are finding individual stocks less accessible due to high prices. This article suggests dividend ETFs under $50 as an alternative, offering diversified exposure and income without a large upfront investment. It highlights five specific dividend ETFs: SCHD, IDOG, IDV, LVHI, and DIV, detailing their fees, yields, and year-to-date performance.

items.title: The Friday Checkout: Can Kroger’s new e-commerce chief sort out its messy online business?
items.summary: Kroger's new chief e-commerce officer, Nate Faust, faces the challenge of streamlining the company's complex and costly online business, particularly its Ocado-powered delivery service. Faust, with his background in founding online services like Jet.com and leading Walmart's e-commerce supply chain, is expected to bring fresh perspectives and logistics expertise to address the inefficiencies and struggles of Kroger's current digital operations. The article highlights the need for Kroger to sort out its online strategy to effectively compete with major players like Walmart and Amazon, especially as its Ocado network faces global challenges and fulfillment shifts towards stores.

items.title: Crocs Raises 2026 Outlook as DTC Growth Helps Offset Tariff Pressure
items.summary: Crocs, Inc. (CROX) has raised its 2026 outlook due to a stronger second quarter, driven by direct-to-consumer growth, international expansion, and new products. These positives are partially offset by weakness in the HEYDUDE brand and tariff-related margin pressures. The company's ability to continue improving channel and geographic momentum will be key to sustaining earnings growth.
